critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/app/domain/house.py:57 catalog.march_skins returns list[{key, requires_unit}] — matches spec + frontend consumer.

/app/backend/app/domain/house.py:77-78 skin_unlocks correctly returns classic:True always (requires_unit=None) and locked skins iff totals[unit] > 0. Uses aggregated garrison + in-flight totals via owned_units (line 65-74) — cheap and accurate.

/app/backend/app/domain/house.py:96-101 PUT validation branches: unknown skin → 400 INVALID_MARCH_SKIN with catalog hint; locked (no unit owned) → 409 MARCH_SKIN_LOCKED with requires_unit. Ordering good (validate key before checking ownership).

/app/backend/app/domain/house.py:115-116 after skin write, update_many pushes 'skin' onto every OUTBOUND/RESOLVING/RETURNING march of the player — matches the review-request 'in-flight marches are updated' clause. Verified in code (no marches in flight at test time so pytest skipped the map/marches assertion; the update path is exercised on every PUT).

/app/backend/app/api/routes_game.py:131-136 POST /worlds/{id}/intro/seen is idempotent: only sets intro_seen_at if missing. Returns {intro_seen:true, server_time}. GET /me maps intro_seen_at → intro_seen boolean via worlds.py:196 dto.

/app/frontend/src/components/cinematic/IntroGate.tsx:16-28 — gates on player.intro_seen + a fired-ref to prevent re-fire on remount within the same world; calls cinematic.play + seen.mutate atomically. Simple, correct.

/app/frontend/src/components/cinematic/Cinematic.tsx:96-113 cinematicPlan correctly maps kind='INTRO' → duration 24000ms, variant 'intro', skipAfterMs 2000. Cinematic HUD hides the composition chips for INTRO (line 344) and shows targetName as the subtitle (line 337) — screenshot confirms 'Regno 1'.

/app/frontend/src/components/cinematic/Cinematic.tsx:192-201 6 intro captions (cinIntro1..6) with i18n substitution for the house name in cinIntro6 (verified: caption-5 read 'Ora la Casata Casa Demo entra nel Regno. Costruisci. Ricerca. Conquista.').

rca_of_issue: No functional issues found. During my first playwright run the intro overlay did NOT appear because demo's intro_seen_at was already true (my very first attempt fired IntroGate → seen.mutate before I set up the poll cadence — a race with page load timing). After manually unsetting intro_seen_at in Mongo, the second run showed the overlay within 1.9s of world_enter — well within the spec's ~5s budget — confirming both the auto-play path and the persistence path work as designed.
